Drift Picnic

Three friends saved a place for you

Tow the leaf raft to a friend · Drag its matching snack onto the mat

A little field guide.

Tow the picnic. Drag an empty edge of the leaf raft to move it. Its springy tow line and gentle drift make it feel afloat.

Serve a friend. Each mat names its snack: BREAD, BERRIES, or MINT. Bring the raft close, then drag the matching snack off the raft onto that friend's mat.

Keep snacks safe. If the raft is too far away or a friend wants something else, the snack returns to the raft. Move the raft closer and try again. Serve all three friends.

Balance and rest. Rearrange snacks on the raft to change its tilt. Two fingers steady the raft. Tap Drift to select Anchor and slow its motion; dragging still tows it.
